saw_lines: Backpack buyers rarely pick on looks alone. They compare weather protection, fit and comfort, then replace the bag when it wears out.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer decides whether to click.
Your site shows 11,670 five-star reviews, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number. Put 11,670 on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 11,670 five-star customer reviews, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number. Buyers comparing packs want proof before they click. Put 11,670 on the creative and in the first line, then open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 15% off, yet only 3 of 18 ads mention it, and all three share one copy. New buyers get no reason to act. Lead three new ads with free shipping on $150+, which 0 of 18 ads mention.

Your site answers how orders ship, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer paying up to $67 wants to know how the bag arrives before clicking. Answer shipping in the first line of ads for new buyers.

Your site lists prices from $26 to $67, yet 0 of 28 ads mention price. Buyers compare cost before picking a pack. Lead one new ad with a single bag price in its first line, showing the $26 to $67 range.
